page.overview:
What is Myrran Swimmer's Club?

Myrran Swimmer's Club was an athletic club that existed in Myrra the capital city of the Outer Rim Territories planet Akiva.

The club was forced to define a no-go zone for training in the western edge of the Great Basin due to increased Hutt Clan activity in 3 ABY At the time a member of the club named Kin Shiff died. The club set out a notice of this news and stressed that the untimely death of Kin Shiff was not related to the Hutt activity. A copy of the notice was kept on a datapad in the Hutt Cartel District of Myrra during 3 ABY.

Myrran Swimmer's Club was mentioned in a datapad in the 2024 Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws published by Ubisoft.
